# Budapest Hungry

> Honest, no-bullshit Budapest tips from Arpi, a local waiter: what to eat, taxis and transport, thermal baths, day trips and Christmas markets. Ask Arpi anything.

Written by Arpi (Arpad), a Budapest waiter. Independent, never sponsored; opinions are personal.

## Budapest and Hungary tips

- [Taxis, apps and public transit](https://budapesthungry.com/posts/taxis-apps-and-public-transit.html): Don't flag down a taxi. Order one, or take public transit.
- [When you need some silence](https://budapesthungry.com/posts/when-you-need-some-silence.html): Budapest is a party town. Take a break from it.
- [The thermal bath at opening time](https://budapesthungry.com/posts/the-thermal-bath-at-opening-time.html): Set the alarm. Thank me later.
- [A Budapest tip: leave Budapest](https://budapesthungry.com/posts/a-budapest-tip-leave-budapest.html): Yes, really. Take a train out of town.
- [The Christmas markets: my honest take](https://budapesthungry.com/posts/the-christmas-markets-my-honest-take.html): Sorry to break your Christmas spirit.
- [Fooooood](https://budapesthungry.com/posts/fooooood.html): Where the locals actually get them.
- [Wine, and Tokaji](https://budapesthungry.com/posts/wine-and-tokaji.html): The exported bottles are not the best of us.
- [Pálinka and Unicum](https://budapesthungry.com/posts/palinka-and-unicum.html): Good quality: sip it. Bad quality: shoot it.
- [Drinking water](https://budapesthungry.com/posts/drinking-water.html): Straight from the tap.
- [Not too cold, please](https://budapesthungry.com/posts/not-too-cold-please.html): This isn't a recommendation, just an interesting fact.
- [Hungarian history in two minutes](https://budapesthungry.com/posts/hungarian-history-in-two-minutes.html): We lost, lost, lost, and we're still here.
- [Topics to handle with care](https://budapesthungry.com/posts/topics-to-handle-with-care.html): Please don't call us Slavic.
- [What Hungarians are proud of](https://budapesthungry.com/posts/what-hungarians-are-proud-of.html): Nod politely. Then have seconds.
- [Hungarian pessimism](https://budapesthungry.com/posts/hungarian-pessimism.html): Prepare for the worst. Anything better feels great.
- [Once we like you](https://budapesthungry.com/posts/once-we-like-you.html): Like family, and no filter.
- [Hungarian brains, mostly abroad](https://budapesthungry.com/posts/hungarian-brains-mostly-abroad.html): Many Nobel Prizes, few won at home.
- [Hungarians love to travel](https://budapesthungry.com/posts/hungarians-love-to-travel.html): Right in the middle of Europe, with flights from $15.
- [The Hungarian language](https://budapesthungry.com/posts/the-hungarian-language.html): Hard to learn, easy to read out loud.

## Arpi's story

- [Born in socialist Hungary](https://budapesthungry.com/posts/born-in-socialist-hungary.html): Bananas showed up three or four times a year.
- [Sunday lunches at grandma's](https://budapesthungry.com/posts/sunday-lunches-at-grandma-s.html): Sour cherry pies, cottage cheese palacsinta, and loud debates.
- [Dad, the divorce and the Pest side](https://budapesthungry.com/posts/dad-the-divorce-and-the-pest-side.html): I cried for days. Then the neighborhood became the coolest in town.
- [The troublemaker](https://budapesthungry.com/posts/the-troublemaker.html): Mustard sandwiches, the Hungarian Parliament on TV, and a brother with straight A's.
- [America, via a chat room](https://budapesthungry.com/posts/america-via-a-chat-room.html): A dial-up modem, a two-year chat and two months like Bonnie and Clyde.
- [Learning hospitality by doing](https://budapesthungry.com/posts/learning-hospitality-by-doing.html): No degree, 150 gadgets and a plush hamburger.
- [Canada, round one: Saskatoon](https://budapesthungry.com/posts/canada-round-one-saskatoon.html): From 2 million people to 200,000, minus 45 C, and my first New York.
- [Ottawa](https://budapesthungry.com/posts/ottawa.html): Apples, rotten tomatoes and a diploma.
- [Back in Budapest, and then Nobu](https://budapesthungry.com/posts/back-in-budapest-and-then-nobu.html): A turn upwards, out of nowhere.
- [Round two: Canada, alone](https://budapesthungry.com/posts/round-two-canada-alone.html): Can I do the Canadian life alone?
- [The Cayman Islands](https://budapesthungry.com/posts/the-cayman-islands.html): The beach was 30 seconds away.
- [COVID in Hungary](https://budapesthungry.com/posts/covid-in-hungary.html): The last plane from London.
- [My moves and 37 countries](https://budapesthungry.com/posts/my-moves-and-37-countries.html): Three continents, a lot of flights and a lot of hellos.
- [Traveling with my mom](https://budapesthungry.com/posts/traveling-with-my-mom.html): She keeps all the pictures.
- [Meet Tobi, my very good dog](https://budapesthungry.com/posts/meet-tobi-my-very-good-dog.html): From the Cayman Islands to Budapest, with a passport full of stamps.
